Assertion dropped, not re-valued.

Assertion dropped.

The library's write table defines code 0x149 (format 9 RGB with type 0xa US_5_6_5; pixel-paths.md host-to-board table, software expectation), so a burst under it is a known form, not 'no layout'. The engine decodes it; the old device only reported it. How the board expands five and six bits is unknown, so the assertion is dropped, not re-valued.
